page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7.32xlarge is a memory-optimized instance built on the x86_64 architecture using KVM virtualization. The instance features 128 dedicated vCPUs powered by Intel Xeon 8369B processors operating at a base clock speed of 2.7 GHz. It provides 1024 GB of RAM, yielding a resource density ratio of 8 GB of memory per vCPU. The server includes no local disk storage, requiring external network-attached storage for persistent data requirements.

Network connectivity for this instance is provided at a baseline rate of 64 Gbps, supporting high throughput for network storage access and multi-node cluster synchronization. The instance does not include integrated GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The substantial memory allocation relative to core count enables processing of large datasets directly within system RAM.

Qualitative cost efficiency is realized through high memory density per node, minimizing the compute overhead needed to support large memory footprints. Primary workload fits include in-memory databases, real-time analytics platforms, enterprise resource planning systems, and batch processing engines requiring extensive RAM allocations.
